prompt: Our Bun test suite takes 25 minutes in CI and keeps getting worse. Around 400 test files, some of them hit a real Postgres database. What can we do?
assertions: The agent recommends bun test --parallel for spreading files across CPU cores.
The agent recommends --shard for splitting across CI machines and --timings/--update-timings for balancing by duration.
The agent mentions BUN_TEST_WORKER_ID or JEST_WORKER_ID for giving each worker its own database/port.
The agent asks discovery/interrogation questions and does NOT write or modify test code in the first turn.
